checks: Programme authoring and records require an active signed-in role
Cross-site mutations, oversized bodies and excessive curriculum inputs are rejected before a programme is created
A complete degree curriculum saves as a draft, with unique identity and protected ownership
Only recorded academic approval opens a valid curriculum, and approved versions cannot be edited in place
Facilitators develop and submit a full certificate through Programme Studio, with advanced policies initially disabled
Mobile learners apply once and cannot register or admit themselves before registry approval
Registry admission records the student number and cohort without silently waiving existing course fees
Recorded programme tuition clearance is explicit, and programme-only courses cannot be self-enrolled directly
Programme registration opens the existing lesson experience with its course snapshot and no duplicate registration
Prerequisites and term-release checks reject bypasses and use released platform results
Core and elective results release the next semester and permit the assessed capstone
Approved recognised credit respects its cap, stays outside GPA and does not automatically issue a degree award
The selected registry-release policy creates the degree certificate only after the final authorised award decision
Final transcripts contain semester GPA, CGPA and only registered or recognised courses, while degree PDFs include a verifiable award
Learner study records download as private PDF and CSV and remain inaccessible to other learners and unassigned staff
Downward source-grade corrections flag the programme award and prevent restoration until eligibility is recovered
A changed final mark triggers transcript review even when the learner remains eligible
Programme award revocation and restoration retain registry control and audit reasons
Earlier platform passes need explicit curriculum permission or recognition, and deferred learners cannot make new registrations
A newly approved curriculum applies to new admissions while existing learners retain their admitted curriculum and results
A two-semester credit-bearing certificate is created automatically only after the last result is released and all credits and GPA requirements pass
Background maintenance rechecks programme requirements and preserves a single certificate identity
Programme authoring, admission and learner records fit a phone viewport and render without page errors
environment: Local production standalone server, Chromium and synthetic academic records
externalServices: No external admission, fee collection, accreditation, AI provider or degree registry service contacted
